description: Run a multi-agent ADVERSARIAL review (parallel spawn_agent hunters, then one verifier per finding) of the working diff BEFORE its pull request is opened (Mode A), and resolve code-review bot comments (Codex, CodeRabbit, Greptile...) in one bounded pass (Mode B). Use it whenever you are about to create or open a PR ("create a PR", "open a PR", "tu peux créer la PR", "ouvre la PR", push a branch for review) or when a bot comments on a PR. On Codex the guard hook (~/.codex/hooks/adversarial-pr-guard.mjs, effective on codex-cli 0.160.0 and later) blocks `gh pr create` until this skill has validated the current HEAD, so reach for it proactively. Two rounds at most, one disposition per finding, then it finishes.
